_comment: GH#92 D3: the room ledger -- its OWN conversation surface so no existing hub's cursor/option pins move (three canonicals broke when the tiers rode erin_errand; lyonette_tip is pinned too). Lyonette keeps the register; tier-1 gates on resolved_wrong_order (HER arc) so the early-game inn stays purchase-free.

hub.speaker: Lyonette
hub.text: The room register. Lyonette's hand, every line ruled straight: names, nights, and three columns of prices that mostly get paid.

text_variants.text: The register has your name against the draughty single now, in Lyonette's ruled hand. Paid, and the column beside it says so.
Your line in the register has been rewritten one column over, neater than it needed to be. Lyonette moved you up herself.
The register lists your room at the top of the page now, underlined once. Lyonette does not underline things twice for anyone.

options._comment: Tier chain: each requires the previous, hides once owned. Persistent +1 max HP each via _room_tier_bonus (wi_game.gd).
options.text: Have the draughty single properly aired and banked. (25 gold)
Pay for the good mattress and the window that shuts. (60 gold)
Best bedding in the inn, under your own window. Whatever it costs. (120 gold)

tier_thanks.speaker: Lyonette
tier_thanks.text: Lyonette enters it without looking up, and the line is perfect anyway. "Paid in full. I'll have it aired by tonight — you'll sleep better than you have been, which frankly is not difficult."

text_variants.text: Lyonette enters it without looking up, and the line is perfect anyway. "Paid in full. Aired, swept, and the draught stopped — you'll get up with more in you than you have been."
Lyonette blots the line and looks up for once. "The good mattress and a window that actually shuts. People underestimate the window. You'll feel the difference the next time something hits you."
Lyonette underlines it. "Best bedding in the house, and I will know if you don't use it. Sleep like that and you walk into the next bad morning with something left over."
